text:
Ellen: hey y'all, excited to join! quick snag on day 2: i can ssh to bastion but docker push to our private ECR keeps failing when i'm on corp-vpn. works from bastion though. anyone seen ecr access blocked for new laptops?
Diego: welcome Ellen! can you paste the exact error from `docker push`?
Ellen: it times out during the TLS handshake: `error: failed to push some refs to \"https://123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/myrepo\"` then `dial tcp: lookup 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com: no such host`
Samir: sounds like private DNS or VPC endpoint not visible to your client. Our ECR sits behind a VPC endpoint with private DNS; onboarding split-tunnel profiles currently don't include the VPC resolver for remote endpoints.
Ellen: ah ok — i tried `nslookup 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` and it fails locally, but on bastion it resolves to the VPC endpoint IP.
Diego: yeah that's the tell. Short-term unblock: port-forward the ECR endpoint through bastion and point docker at localhost. Example: `ssh -L 5010:vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h.vpce-svc-abcdef.us-west-2.vpce.amazonaws.com:443 ubuntu@bastion.company` then `docker --config /tmp/docker-config login -u AWS -p $(aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2) https://localhost:5010` and push to `https://localhost:5010/myrepo`. It's a bit fiddly but works for a short session.
Ellen: okay tried the ssh -L approach and `docker login` to localhost:5010 succeeded, `docker push` is uploading layers now. Thanks!
Samir: for longer term, infra will either add the ECR VPC endpoint's private DNS to the onboarding WireGuard profile or provide an authenticated bastion-side proxy for registry access. SecOps needs to approve exposing the internal resolver to remote laptops.
Ellen: FYI i'm on macOS Sonoma, M1 MacBook Air, using the corp WireGuard wrapper. Does M1 or macOS change anything?
Diego: Not really for DNS/routing, but we do have a handful of M1 machines where the kernel extension version of the client needed an update. If you see the client failing to install routes at connect time, ping here. For now your ssh-tunnel workaround is good.
Ellen: sweet. infra-bot could you open a ticket so we don't lose this? i'll add my laptop model/serial to speed SecOps review.
infra-bot: Created INFRA-7001: "onboarding: expose ECR VPC endpoint DNS or provide bastion proxy for new hires" assigned to @Diego. Requested SecOps review. SLA: 72h.
Samir: optional alternative if SecOps prefers no DNS exposure: we can grant short-lived bastion-proxy creds (OAuth token) that new hires use to push images; that'll keep resolver internal. i'll propose both in the ticket.
Ellen: awesome, thanks everyone 60a i'm unblocked and excited to start contributing :)
Diego: welcome aboard! ping this thread if INFRA-7001 doesn't progress in 3 days and we'll escalate.
